verdict.rationale: Cua documents a versioned drive (Cua Volume) with an audit log for agent memory and outputs, and named agents with routines the daemon fires. Nothing shows that the automations or routines themselves can be versioned, reviewed as changes, or rolled back to a prior version. The versioned drive is an adjacent storage feature, not versioning of automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
